title: Voiceover Project Request
description: Input to the `Voiceover Project` reusable workflow (and its dev test webhook). Mirrors the Step 6/7 orchestrator request shape exactly — see docs/architecture/voiceover-pipeline.md#input.

force_regenerate_chunk_ids.description: Chunk IDs to force-regenerate even if a completed, identity-matching chunk exists (targeted human revision).

revision_trigger.description: Why this run was started. Defaults to initial_generation when omitted.

revision_reason.description: Reviewer-supplied reason, present when revision_trigger is revision_requested.

_dev_fail_after_step.description: Dev-only failure-injection escape hatch — never part of the public contract.
